results.name: Barbell Seated Overhead Triceps Press
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor, maintaining an upright posture. Hold a barbell with a close grip (palms facing up), hands positioned slightly narrower than shoulder-width apart.
Position the barbell behind your head with your elbows bent and pointing upwards. Press the barbell overhead by extending your elbows until your arms are fully extended.
Lower the barbell back down to the starting position with control, bending your elbows.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Maintain an upright posture to ensure proper form and avoid leaning forward.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
Ensure your elbows stay pointed upwards to maintain proper alignment and effectively target the triceps.
results.description: Barbell Seated Overhead Triceps Press is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders.

results.name: Barbell Standing Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell with an overhand grip (palms facing forward), hands placed closer than shoulder-width apart. Lift the barbell overhead, fully extending your arms. Your elbows should be close to your head.
Slowly lower the barbell behind your head by bending your elbows, keeping your upper arms stationary.
Lower the barbell until your forearms are parallel to the floor, feeling the stretch in your triceps.
Press the barbell back up to the starting position by extending your arms fully. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your upper arms stationary and close to your head throughout the movement to isolate your triceps.
Focus on smooth, controlled movements to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
Use a weight that allows for proper form and control throughout the exercise to prevent strain or injury.
results.description: Barbell Standing Overhead Triceps Extension is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders.

results.name: Bench Dip (Knees Bent)
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench with your hands placed on the bench beside your hips.
Slide your hips off the bench, supporting your body with your hands, and bend your knees at a 90-degree angle with your feet flat on the floor.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Push through your palms to raise your body back to the starting position.
tips: Keep your elbows pointed backward and close to your body to engage your triceps effectively.
Avoid locking your elbows at the top of the movement to maintain tension in your triceps.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
results.description: Bench Dip (Knees Bent) is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Chest, Shoulders.

results.name: Bench Dip on Floor
instructions: Sit on a bench and place your hands on its edge near your hips.
Walk your feet out, extend your legs, shift your weight on heels, and take your hips off the bench while holding the bench with straight arms.
Lower your hips down by folding your arms and legs.
As your arms form a 90-degree angle, raise your hips and repeat.
tips: Keep your elbows pointed backward and close to your body to engage your triceps effectively.
Engage your core and glutes to keep your body stable.
Keep your shoulders down and away from your ears to avoid strain and ensure proper alignment.
results.description: Bench Dip on Floor is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Chest, Shoulders.

results.name: Bench Triceps Dip Leg Curls
instructions: Sit down on a bench and place your hands on its edge near your hips.
Walk your feet out, extend your legs, and lift your hips off the bench while holding the bench.
Lower your hips down by folding your arms and bending your knees.
As your arms form a 90-degree angle, raise your hips while extending your legs, and repeat.
tips: Keep your elbows pointed backward and close to your body to engage your triceps effectively.
Maintain a controlled movement for both the dip and the leg curl to maximize muscle activation.
Engage your core to maintain stability and proper form throughout the exercise.
results.description: Bench Triceps Dip Leg Curls is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Chest, Shoulders.

results.name: Bench Triceps Dip Straight Legs
instructions: Sit down on a bench and place your hands on the edge near your hips.
Walk your feet out, straighten your legs, and lift your hips off the bench while holding the bench.
Lower your hips down by folding your arms.
As your arms form a 90-degree angle, raise your hips, and repeat.
tips: Keep your elbows pointed backward and close to your body to engage your triceps effectively.
Maintain a straight line from your hips to your heels to ensure proper form.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
results.description: Bench Triceps Dip Straight Legs is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Chest, Shoulders.

results.name: Body-Up
instructions: Start in a plank position with your hands placed directly under your shoulders and your body forming a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your body towards the floor by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your torso.
Push through your palms to lift your body back up to the starting plank position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Triceps (Triceps Brachii), Chest (Pectoralis Major)
results.description: Body-Up is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back, Glutes.

results.name: Bodyweight Kneeling Triceps Extension
instructions: Start in a kneeling position with your knees on the floor. Place your hands on the floor in front of you opposite your head, close together, and lean forward.
Bend your elbows to lower your forearms and head towards the floor, engaging your triceps.
Push through your hands to extend your arms back to the starting position, straightening your elbows.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your body stable by engaging your core throughout the movement.
Keep your elbows close to your body to target the triceps more effectively.
Control the movement, avoiding any jerking motions, to enhance muscle engagement and prevent injury.
results.description: Bodyweight Kneeling Triceps Extension is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Chest.

results.name: Bodyweight Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended overhead with hands holding together, elbows slightly bent.
Bend your elbows to lower your hands behind your head, engaging your triceps.
Extend your arms back to the starting overhead position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your upper arms stationary and close to your ears throughout the exercise to effectively target the triceps.
Engage your core to maintain stability and avoid arching your back.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
results.description: Bodyweight Overhead Triceps Extension is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders.

results.name: Bodyweight Triceps Extension
instructions: Begin in a plank position on your toes and elbows, with your hands positioned at shoulder-width apart, palms on the floor.
Push through your palms to extend your arms straight, keeping your palms in place.
Lower your forearms to the floor back to the starting plank position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels to maintain proper form.
Engage your core to stabilize your body and prevent your hips from sagging.
Focus on your breathing; inhale as you lower your forearms and exhale as you extend your arms back to the plank position.
results.description: Bodyweight Triceps Extension is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Chest.
